title: Haste for the Happy Ghast
description: This datapack adds Haste I II III enchantments to the world for the happy Ghasts harness to increases its speed
body: Haste increases a Happy Ghast’s sustained flight speed, allowing for faster travel through the air. At Haste I, flight speed is similar to a sprinting player; Haste II provides a clear midpoint increase; and Haste III enables flight comparable to the fastest horses, reaching roughly fourteen blocks per second. This enchantment can only be applied to a Happy Ghast harness and has no effect unless the ghast is harnessed. Haste is obtained through standard enchantment methods such as enchanting tables, loot generation, or villager trading
